faqs.question: How fast can we launch?
faqs.answer: Most teams launch their first campaign the same day they sign up, using Valley's guided setup and a starter play matched to your ICP.

faqs.question: Do you replace our CRM?
faqs.answer: No. Valley plugs into your existing CRM and syncs activity both ways, so your pipeline stays the single source of truth your team already trusts.

faqs.question: Is there a contract?
faqs.answer: Plans are month-to-month by default. Annual and quarterly billing are available and include a discount, with no long-term lock-in required.

faqs.question: What channels does Valley support?
faqs.answer: Email and LinkedIn today, with more channels on the roadmap. Every sequence can mix channels based on the signal that triggered it.
